settings.config_dir.label: Config directory
settings.config_dir.description: Where input-remapper keeps presets/ and config.json. Default for version 2.x is ~/.config/input-remapper-2.
settings.control_cmd.label: Control command
settings.control_cmd.description: The executable used to talk to the daemon. Leave as input-remapper-control unless you need a wrapper such as 'sudo -n input-remapper-control'. Inserted unquoted, so it may contain arguments.
settings.poll_seconds.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
settings.poll_seconds.description: How often the preset list is rescanned and the daemon is pinged.
settings.hide_empty_devices.label: Hide devices without presets
settings.hide_empty_devices.description: Skip preset folders that contain no .json files.
settings.on_startup.label: On Noctalia start
settings.on_startup.description: What to do with the injection state remembered from the previous session.
settings.detect_connected.label: Detect connected devices
settings.detect_connected.description: Read /proc/bus/input/devices to split the list into Connected and Saved. Turn off to show every preset folder in one list.
settings.scroll_height.label: Scroll area height (0 = automatic)
settings.scroll_height.description: Leave at 0 to let the list take whatever space is left below the header. Set a pixel value only if the footer buttons get pushed off the bottom of the panel.
settings.debug_log.label: Write a debug log
settings.debug_log.description: Append diagnostics to debug.log in this plugin's data directory. Useful while troubleshooting; turn off once things are stable.
settings.show_label.label: Show preset name in the bar
settings.show_label.description: When exactly one injection is running, print its preset name next to the glyph.
settings.max_label_chars.label: Maximum label length
settings.max_label_chars.description: Preset names longer than this are truncated in the bar.
panel.title: Input Remapper
panel.none_connected: None of your preset folders match a device that is plugged in right now. Open Saved Devices below, or turn off connection detection in the plugin settings.
panel.no_devices_hint: Nothing under presets/ in the configured directory. Check the plugin settings, or create a preset in input-remapper first.
notify.generic_body: input-remapper-control returned an error. Check the Noctalia log for details.
widget.idle:
Input Remapper
Nothing is being remapped.
widget.daemon_down:
Input Remapper
The input-remapper daemon is not reachable.
notify.kbm_start_failed: Could not start keyboard & mouse mode
notify.kbm_stop_failed: Could not stop keyboard & mouse mode
settings.kbm_scale.label: Keyboard & Mouse: cursor range
settings.kbm_scale.description: How far a fully deflected left stick moves the cursor, as a fraction of the way from the screen center to the edge.
settings.kbm_deadzone.label: Keyboard & Mouse: stick deadzone
settings.kbm_deadzone.description: Fraction of the stick range around center that is ignored. Raise it if the cursor creeps while the stick is untouched.
settings.kbm_smoothing.label: Keyboard & Mouse: smooth the cursor
settings.kbm_smoothing.description: Filter out stick jitter with a One Euro filter.
settings.kbm_min_cutoff.label: Keyboard & Mouse: smoothing at rest
settings.kbm_min_cutoff.description: Filter cutoff in Hz while the stick moves slowly. Lower means less jitter but more lag on slow movements.
settings.kbm_beta.label: Keyboard & Mouse: smoothing on quick moves
settings.kbm_beta.description: How quickly smoothing backs off as the stick moves faster. Higher means less lag on quick flicks but more jitter.
settings.kbm_trigger_mode.label: Keyboard & Mouse: R2 / L2
settings.kbm_trigger_mode.description: How the triggers drive the left / right mouse buttons.
settings.kbm_pwm_hz.label: Keyboard & Mouse: pulses per second
settings.kbm_pwm_hz.description: Pulse rate in analog trigger mode. Raise it if a half-pulled trigger feels jerky.
settings.kbm_pwm_min_pulse.label: Keyboard & Mouse: shortest pulse (s)
settings.kbm_pwm_min_pulse.description: Shortest click in analog trigger mode. Raise it if a lightly pulled trigger does nothing in game.
panel.kbm_hint: Left stick moves the cursor, R2 / L2 click. Buttons follow the preset below.
panel.kbm_unusable: No mapping works as keyboard & mouse
settings.kbm_cursor_y.label: Keyboard & Mouse: cursor height
settings.kbm_cursor_y.description: Where the cursor sits vertically, 0 = top of the screen, 1 = bottom. Move it off the game's on-screen buttons.
